title: video
description:
Client -> robot. Encoder control for the composited video track. Intercepted by the bridge; it never reaches the motion daemon, which is why it is session-layer.

Exactly one of `state`, `bitrate` or `quality` per frame. All three are REQUESTS: the robot applies its own thermal and load ceiling on top and may deliver less than asked. There is no reply message -- observe the received track to see what actually happened.

The robot defaults to flowing, so a client that wants video need send nothing; only send `state: "pause"` when you actively want it stopped (power saving on a battery robot).

state.description: Stop or restart the encoder. A pause requested before the control channel opened should be re-sent on open.

quality.description: Named preset, for clients that do not run their own bitrate loop.
